joinToken.title: Add a voter
joinToken.intro: Creates a one-time join token for a new voter. It is shown only once and expires after the chosen time.
joinToken.onceOnly: Copy the token now. It is not shown again and is not stored anywhere in the UI.
joinToken.howTo: Save the token in a file on the new node and start it with an empty data directory and:
joinToken.fileHint: JOIN_TOKEN_FILE keeps the token out of the process environment. See docs/betrieb/cluster.md.

error.forbidden: Only platform admins can administer the cluster.
error.unavailable: The cluster is not available right now (no leader or no CA yet). Try again shortly.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.noLeader: No leader is known. Writes are refused until an election succeeds.
cluster.upgradePending: A rolling update is in progress: not all voters support the same command version yet.

node.clockWarning: The clock differs by 2 s or more. Enable NTP on all nodes.

blocked.leader: The leader cannot remove itself. Stop its container so another voter takes over, then remove it.
blocked.lastVoter: The last voter cannot be removed.

risk.noReserve: Fewer than three voters remain: the cluster has no failure reserve.
risk.even: An even number of voters adds no fault tolerance. An odd number is recommended.

remove.title: Remove node
remove.text: Remove “{{ name }}” from the cluster? It stops taking part in the Raft group and no longer receives replicated data.

replace.title: Replace node
replace.text: “{{ name }}” is removed from the cluster first. Then you add a new voter with a join token.
replace.warnReserve: Until the new node has joined, the cluster has less failure reserve.
replace.warnData: Do not reuse the old node's data directory. The new node must start with an empty data directory and gets a new node ID.
replace.joinHint: Start the new node with an empty data directory. Do not reuse the data directory of the removed node.

error.notMember: This node is not a member of the cluster.
error.conflict: The cluster refused the change because of its current state.

alerts.title: Active system alerts
alerts.loadError: The system alerts could not be loaded.
alerts.subject: Subject

failure.offline: The server cannot be reached. Please try again.
failure.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
failure.conflict: The change conflicts with the current state.
failure.unavailable: The cluster is not available right now. Please try again.

limits.planValueNotEnforced: Plan: {{ value }}. Saved now, enforced once the feature exists.
limits.rule: Enter a whole number from {{ min }} to {{ max }}.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.exceededTitle: Limits exceeded: existing items keep running, new ones are refused.

exceeded.minIntervalSeconds: Shortest interval {{ actual }} s, minimum {{ allowed }} s

suspendDialog.title: Suspend tenant?
suspendDialog.text: Its users are signed out and refused, and its checks and alerts stop. The data is kept; you can resume at any time.

lock.suspendFirst: Suspend the tenant first. Only suspended tenants can be deleted.

dialog.idHint: Optional: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Empty generates an ID.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.orgIdHint: Optional. Binds the tenant to an organization of the identity provider.
dialog.orgIdLocked: Set by the server configuration; cannot be changed here.
dialog.limitsHint: Empty inherits the plan's value. Unlimited removes the limit for this tenant.

errors.id: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.name: Enter a name.

delete.title: Delete tenant “{{ name }}”?
delete.text: All data of this tenant is deleted: monitors, check results, incidents, channels, maintenance windows and users. This cannot be undone.
delete.copies: Copies remain in the Raft log and in backups until they are overwritten.

lock.default: The default plan cannot be deleted.
lock.inUse: A plan that tenants use cannot be deleted.

delete.title: Delete plan?
delete.text: The plan is removed. Tenants can no longer be put on it.

dialog.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The ID cannot be changed later.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.limitsHint: A lowered limit keeps the existing items of the tenants. Only new objects and shorter intervals are refused.

errors.pattern: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64 characters.
errors.taken: A plan with this ID already exists.
errors.name: Enter a name.
